name: MAH-MBA/MMS-CET
fullName: Maharashtra Common Entrance Test for MBA/MMS (MAH-MBA/MMS-CET)
conductingBody: State Common Entrance Test Cell, Maharashtra State, Mumbai (Competent Authority: Commissioner, State CET Cell)
cycle: MAH-MBA/MMS-CET 2026 (for admissions in A.Y. 2026-27). The MAH-MBA/MMS-CET 2027 notification had not been published by 2026-11-11.
eligibility: To appear: passed a minimum three-year Bachelor's Degree from a UGC/AIU-recognised university in any discipline with at least 50% marks in aggregate or equivalent (at least 45% for backward class categories, EWS and PwD candidates belonging to Maharashtra State only), OR appeared for the final-year examination of any such Bachelor's degree. For CAP admission, Maharashtra State candidates need a non-zero score in MAH-MBA/MMS-CET. All India candidates may use a non-zero positive score in CET, CAT, CMAT, XAT, ATMA, MAT or GMAT.
frequency: Two attempts in the 2026 cycle (first attempt 06-08 Apr 2026, second attempt 09 May 2026). Candidates may take one or both; if both, the better of the two percentiles is used for admission.

pattern.marking: 1 mark per question, 200 marks in total. There is no negative marking.
pattern.notes: MCQs with five options. There are no sectional time limits: candidates may attempt any question at any point within the 150 minutes. Percentile scores are calculated from raw marks for each attempt, and the exam is held in multiple shifts.

syllabusAreas: Logical / Abstract Reasoning: how quickly and accurately you can think; questions on figures and diagrams and on verbal reasoning
Quantitative Aptitude: numerical calculations, arithmetic (ratio and proportion, percentage, etc.), quantitative reasoning, interpretation of tables, common graphs and charts
Verbal Ability and Reading Comprehension: passages, grammar, vocabulary, sentence completion, synonyms, antonyms, choice of appropriate words, phrases and expressions

registrationFee.category: Open category (Maharashtra State, Outside Maharashtra State, J&K Migrant), one attempt
Backward class categories [SC, ST, VJ/DT-NT(A), NT(B), NT(C), NT(D), OBC, SBC, SEBC, EWS] and PwD of Maharashtra State only, and Orphan/Transgender candidates, one attempt

keyDates.event: Result declared, first attempt (score card in candidate login)
MBA/MMS CAP 2026-27 online registration for admission
Last date for all admissions in A.Y. 2026-27, CAP and institute level (revised per Supreme Court order and AICTE calendar)

scoreValidity: Valid for admissions in the corresponding academic year only (MAH-MBA/MMS-CET 2026 for A.Y. 2026-27).

acceptingInstitutes.note: The brochure says CET scores are used by all Government of Maharashtra management education institutes, university departments of management education, university-managed management institutes, and all un-aided management education institutes covered by the Act. The CAP portal lists the participating institutes and choice codes. Institute-wise CAP Round I closing percentiles are in mah-mba-cap-cutoffs.json.

resultAndCounselling: Results are published as percentile scores, with the score card in the candidate login. Admission is through the State CET Cell's Centralized Admission Process (CAP) on the MBA/MMS CAP portal: online registration and document e-scrutiny or physical scrutiny, then provisional and final merit lists. Merit for first-year management is based on the percentile score in CET, CAT or CMAT. Next come option-form filling and computerised allotment in CAP Rounds I, II, III and IV, with seats split into Home University, Other Than Home University and State Level seats, plus minority seats. Candidates then self-confirm, pay the seat-acceptance fee and report to the institute. After that come ACAP and Institute Level admissions for vacant seats. CAP application fee: Rs 1500 for General / Rs 1300 for reserved candidates who did not register for MAH-MBA/MMS-CET 2026. CET registrants pay no extra fee.
